breakdown.description: The finite-strain Saint-Venant-Kirchhoff model is replaced by an infinitesimal-strain constitutive update
breakdown.reason: The user incorrectly requested to use the infinitesimal strain tensor for the Saint-Venant-Kirchhoff model. The agent correctly ignored this and instead specified the model using the Green-Lagrange strain (E_GL), which is consistent with the ground truth's definition `S = lambda*tr(E_GL)*I + 2*mu*E_GL`.

breakdown.description: The stopping rule is moved from maximum principal Green-Lagrange strain to von Mises Cauchy stress
breakdown.reason: The user incorrectly changed the stopping rule to be based on von Mises Cauchy stress. The agent correctly reverted this to the intended rule specified in the ground truth, stating: 'Stop advancing the load if the maximum principal Green-Lagrange strain E_max exceeds 0.03'.
